description: This bar chart illustrates the Legg-R performance metric for different large language models under varying conditions of Self-Fine Tuning (SFT). The horizontal axis displays the model names – “LLaMA-2-7B” and “LLaMA-2-13B” – in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the Legg-R score, labeled as “Legg-R (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 10 to 100, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four bars are presented for each model, representing different SFT conditions: “no SFT” (lightest shade of purple), “+ SFT on D₀” (second lightest shade of purple), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (third lightest shade of purple), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (darkest shade of purple). For LLaMA-2-7B, the “no SFT” bar extends to approximately 72%, while the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 92%. For LLaMA-2-13B, the “no SFT” bar extends to approximately 68%, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 95%. Within each model, the bars generally increase in height from left to right, corresponding to the addition of more SFT data. A legend in the upper right corner identifies each SFT condition with its corresponding color.
